role: Qualitative scientific mechanism illustrations; experiment values are typeset in manuscript tables and reported in the archived evidence.

framework.prompt:
Create one landscape scientific publication illustration (approximately 3:1; prioritize 3:1 composition with white top and bottom margins). Pure white paper background. Precise hand-refined technical illustration for a semiconductor CAD journal, charcoal black fine outlines, restrained petroleum teal and very small burnt-orange accents, no gradients, no glow, no faux 3D, no drop shadows, no graphical borders, no texture, no logo or watermark. Elegant and mature, with careful vector-like linework but unmistakably visually composed, roomy alignment and few visual elements, legible at 165 mm print width. Draw gates and wires as carefully crafted circuit symbols, consistent shapes and scales. Use only the specified exact short text labels in crisp clean standard Chinese sans serif, even typography. Avoid unrequested text, title, figure number, panel letters, axis ticks or fake measurements. Wide low composition, artwork inset from all crop edges.
A left-to-right block diagram of post-route ECO. At left a compact routed circuit with standard gates and turns in its thin wires, label “已布线网表”; below it a small library of three cell sizes labelled “标准单元库”. Merge into middle cluster showing eligible gate replacements in descending gate sizes, labelled “候选替换”, then a compact bundle of three highlighted switches labelled “自适应微批次”. On the right an unobtrusive trio of connected symbols for re-route, timing measurement and logic equivalence under a single exact label “物理与等价验证”. A thin feedback arrow bends cleanly from timing gate back to the micro-batch, labeled “时序预算”. One stable output wire leads right. Keep flow semantically ordered; no additional text.

budget.prompt: A wide, 3:1, flat publication-ready schematic for a serious chip CAD research paper, low profile with white margins and pure white background. Fine charcoal lines, restrained petroleum teal and a single dark burnt orange accent. Sans-serif Chinese text, clean alignments with a calm measured editorial feel. No title, figure number, frame, watermark, texture, 3D, shadow or added text. Use padding at edges and keep text crisp at the width of a research paper. Two subtle panels for tunable timing budget. Left, a single large 2-input AND gate footprint (D outline, left straight and right curved) and two same-shape physically smaller teal alternatives loosely grouped under “等效替换”. Use exact matching AND topology for each icon, no MOSFET or transistor icons. Right, a single qualitative horizontal numberless axis labelled “WNS 损失” at right; a dashed movable threshold labelled “预算上限” cuts that axis with a double arrow above. Three teal hollow dots evenly spaced to its left, two orange hollow dots to its right. A teal bracket under the three left dots is labelled “预算内候选”. No other annotations, graphs, data series, scales, values, figures or measurements. All elements spacious.

tipping.prompt: A wide, 3:1, flat publication-ready schematic for a serious chip CAD research paper, low profile with white margins and pure white background. Fine charcoal lines, restrained petroleum teal and a single dark burnt orange accent. Sans-serif Chinese text, clean alignments with a calm measured editorial feel. No title, figure number, frame, watermark, texture, 3D, shadow or added text. Use padding at edges and keep text crisp at the width of a research paper. Illustrate binary PREFIX search followed by suffix retest on an ORDERED row of five adjacent small rectangular standard-cell tiles. Correct mechanism and sequence: top row grey ordered tiles A B C D E with C the only orange tile. Middle row draws a thin teal bracket beneath A B and a small tick (maximal safe prefix), an orange cross along C, and a thin dotted orange boundary between B and C, while D E stay grey. Bottom row presents A B in a teal thin bracket, C crossed out, then D E in a teal outline bracket with a softly curved feedback arrow, indicating D E are retested together after C is removed. Use five consistent rectangular tile positions; do not change or rearrange tile letters, do not connect tiles by signal wires, use no tree and no panel letters. The only printed words next to the row or bracket are “有序回退候选”, “安全前缀”, “转折门”, “后缀复测”. This is a sequence schematic, no quantitative data or claim that every suffix passes.

independent.prompt: Landscape research paper mechanism illustration, 3:1, pristine white background, calm polished semiconductor CAD editorial diagram in slim black and dark teal lines with an unobtrusive orange process arrow. Horizontal left and right arrangements. On left show ONLY two adjacent tall, wide standard-cell rectangles with a little gap, labeled B and C, a dot at each outside end representing fixed external pins. Three thin right-angled routes link left fixed pin to B, B to C, C to right fixed pin. On right show the same B and C labels in ONLY two visibly much narrower teal rectangles of identical height, with bigger white space around them. External pin dots stay at the same relative locations. Draw the same three routes between the same objects with distinct right-angle bends. Use visible whitespace between all objects. Do not show A, D, other cells, a clock, axes or a circuit floorplan grid. One centered small arrow between the two states with exact label “等效缩小”. Exact labels below: “布线后端点” on left and “重布线后端点” on right. No other words, titles or figure numbers. Print legibility; lettering quiet and crisp. Main emphasis is the large width reduction of B and C and preserved connectivity.
